title: DOW-UAP-PR106, Unresolved UAP Report, Eastern United States, 2020
what_is_it: A U.S. government video release: 11 seconds of infrared sensor footage of an unresolved unidentified anomalous phenomenon (UAP), catalogued as DOW-UAP-PR106.
interpretation_warnings: The footage was digitally altered before being reported to AARO, which limits its evidentiary value.
No source text could be extracted from the PDF; findings rely on war.gov metadata and the official video description.
Apparent rapid movement of the object is attributed to the infrared sensor switching modes, not necessarily to the object itself.
Object descriptors (small, metallic, reflective underside) derive from a single accompanying debrief (DOW-UAP-D089), not independent confirmation.
The case is labelled unresolved; 'unidentified' does not imply any specific explanation.
